page: Amazon Web Services r6idn.32xlarge is an x86_64 memory-optimized instance built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture. It is powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8375C processor running at 3.5 GHz across 64 physical cores and 128 vCPUs. The hardware configuration integrates 1024.0 GB of DDR4 system memory clocked at 3 GHz, offering an 8 GB per vCPU ratio. Storage and network capabilities include 7600 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 200 Gbps. It contains no discrete GPUs.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong parallel computational and memory throughput. The instance achieves top-tier performance in PassMark CPU testing (86426.81) along with top 10% marks in PassMark encryption and ray tracing. Multi-core performance is confirmed by a strong stress-ng score of 123839.46 and a Geekbench multi-core rating of 16294.0. In contrast, single-core evaluations—such as stress-ng single-core (1891.79) and Geekbench single-core (1683.0)—fall within the average tier, underscoring that throughput is driven by core density and parallelism rather than extreme single-thread execution speeds.

Memory and network-bound subsystem benchmarks reflect high efficiency for distributed and stateful applications. The memory architecture registers 331.59 GB/sec in uncached 256 MB block reads and 135.26 GB/sec in uncached block writes. Static web serving throughput reaches 69.9 GB/sec, accompanied by 108.32 million operations per second in Redis SET operations and strong PassMark database scores. CPU-based LLM inference reflects strong prompt processing speeds, though generation rates on larger 70B models remain modest without hardware accelerators.

The r6idn.32xlarge configuration balances dense memory resources, fast local NVMe storage, and 200 Gbps networking. This architecture is well suited for memory-intensive operational workloads, including in-memory databases like Redis, distributed data processing engines, large-scale relational databases, real-time analytics pipelines, and high-concurrency caching tiers.
description: Amazon Web Services r6idn.32xlarge is an x86_64 memory-optimized instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor and an Intel Xeon 8375C processor at 3.5 GHz. The system provides 128 dedicated vCPUs (64 physical cores), 1024.0 GB of DDR4 memory, 7600 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, and a 200 Gbps network interface. The instance features no discrete GPU accelerators. Benchmarks highlight upper-tier multi-threaded execution, with top-tier results in PassMark CPU and encryption tests alongside strong multi-core stress-ng throughput. Memory benchmarks display 331.59 GB/sec in large-block read bandwidth, complementing high in-memory Redis throughput exceeding 108 million operations per second. While single-thread performance tests sit within median tiers, the high memory-per-core ratio and rapid local NVMe storage make this server well suited for in-memory databases, large data caches, big data analytics, and relational database hosting.
